builds.name: Reference: Ranked support core
builds.goal: Reference for Milio: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ support players use most (3,162 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 61.6% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A protective enchanter who improves an ally's attack reach and repeated damage while using kick displacement and cleansing to deny engages. The current support provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Echoes of Helia → Moonstone Renewer → Ardent Censer. Summon Aery keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Ionian Boots of Lucidity, Dream Maker, Redemption.
builds.summary: The proven support baseline: Echoes of Helia → Moonstone Renewer → Ardent Censer, with Summon Aery.
testPlan: Play it in support as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Echoes of Helia → Moonstone Renewer → Ardent Censer) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 61.6% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Echoes of Helia → Moonstone Renewer → Ardent Censer.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Milio kicks a fireball, Knocking Back the first enemy hit. If it hits, the ball bounces past them and explodes, dealing [80 / 140 / 200 / 260 / 320 + (1.2) × AP] magic damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by [0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5 / 0.55 / 0.6 + (0.0005) × AP] for [1.5] seconds.

Hitting at least one enemy champion with {{Spell_MilioKickballQ_Name}} refunds [50]% of it's Mana cost.

When Milio's Abilities touch ally champions, their next Attack or Ability deals [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.07, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.03999999910593033, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.03999999910593033, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] ally Attack Damage as additional magic damage, plus [UNRESOLVED({ee18a47b}; see calculationRaw) + (0.2) × AP] magic damage over [1.5] seconds.

Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames on nearby ally champions, cleansing Disabling and Immobilizing effects, restoring [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.5) × AP] Health, and granting [65]% Tenacity for [3] seconds.

Milio wraps an ally champion in protective flames, granting [45 / 75 / 105 / 135 / 165 + (0.45) × AP] Shield and [(0.12 / 0.14 / 0.16 / 0.18 / 0.2) × 100]% Move Speed for [2.5] seconds.

This ability has 2 charges and the effects stack on repeat targets.

Milio creates a hearth that follows ally champions for [6] seconds. Ally champions nearby gain [0.1 / 0.125 / 0.15 / 0.175 / 0.2] Attack Range and restore [70 / 90 / 110 / 130 / 150 + (0.15) × AP] Health over the duration. The hearth also applies {{Spell_MilioPassive_Name}} every [3] seconds.

Recast: Change the hearth's follow ally.

builds.name: Kick Ap Countercatch
builds.summary: Separate knockback mark and explosion hit reliability.
builds.goal: Separate knockback mark and explosion hit reliability.
builds.hypothesis: Q has 1.2 AP magic damage, AP-scaled slow and champion-hit mana refund. Mandate can use the first enemy knockback; AP also improves E shields and R healing. Rocketbelt tests approach angle while Horizon reveals a long-range bounce target rather than supplying unlisted damage amplification.
testPlan: Required state: Ball knocks back the first champion and bounce explosion catches intended enemies.
Separate knockback mark and explosion hit reliability; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: AP income requirement loses support utility and unsafe positioning prevents Q.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Horizon reveal is not a damage multiplier in this catalog.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Hextech Rocketbelt, Imperial Mandate, Horizon Focus, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cryptbloom, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Tempo and pursuit
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Milio: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A protective enchanter who improves an ally's attack reach and repeated damage while using kick displacement and cleansing to deny engages. Measure eligible ally attacks/abilities consuming passive fire, range assistance and R cleansing. Personal AP damage must repay lost carry uptime and cannot cleanse every CC category. Movement tools and compatible control marks test coordinated pursuit or escape.
builds.summary: Movement tools and compatible control marks test coordinated pursuit or escape.
testPlan: Kit question for Milio: Measure eligible ally attacks/abilities consuming passive fire, range assistance and R cleansing. Personal AP damage must repay lost carry uptime and cannot cleanse every CC category.

Start with the early core (Support quest, Shurelya or Mandate according to the kit) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use real support income and keep the quest/vision slot.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Movement tools and compatible control marks test coordinated pursuit or escape. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Mandate needs eligible control and allied follow-up; speed is not guaranteed damage.

The route fails Milio's stated kit question: Measure eligible ally attacks/abilities consuming passive fire, range assistance and R cleansing. Personal AP damage must repay lost carry uptime and cannot cleanse every CC category.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility. Also record allies lost while spending on personal damage.
tradeoffs: Mandate needs eligible control and allied follow-up; speed is not guaranteed damage.
Full cost 10,600 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Support quest, Shurelya or Mandate according to the kit. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Begin with the actual support quest item; Celestial Opposition is earned by transformation, not directly bought as a 400-gold legendary. Keep buying vision.
Imperial Mandate, Redemption, Mikael's Blessing are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.summary: Count P consumptions across campfire ticks and two E casts.
builds.goal: Count P consumptions across campfire ticks and two E casts.
builds.hypothesis: W reapplies P every three seconds during six seconds of range/heal support; P's initial packet scales with ally AD while burn has Milio AP. Staff/Helia and Dream Maker reward allied heals/shields, but P attribution and bubble consumption must be observed. E charges can maintain access after W expires.
testPlan: Required state: Ally uses each granted P before refresh; record ally AD and support income.
Count P consumptions across campfire ticks and two E casts; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

failureConditions: Unspent P is overwritten or lack of enemy damage leaves Helia empty.
